description: ACCDB (r-q47 follow-up): seeds T(ID PK, G LONG, B BIGINT) with mixed Null + extreme values: G=1 {Null, min}, G=2 {Null, max}, G=3 {Null, min, max}, G=4 {Null, min+1, max}, G=5 {min, min}, G=6 {max, max}. Runs separate SUM(B), AVG(B), and MIN/MAX/COUNT queries for each group via both DAO and ADO with full metadata.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, G LONG, B BIGINT)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (1, 1, Null)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (3, 2, Null)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (4, 2, 9223372036854775807)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (5, 3, Null)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (7, 3, 9223372036854775807)
INSERT INTO T VALUES (8, 4, Null)
